description: Trigger eval set for the AI Engineering Kit. 15 should-trigger queries + 10 near-miss queries (7 near-miss positives, 3 near-miss negatives). Derived from docs/skills-audit-and-plan-2026-10-23.md §8.1.

rules.pass: A query passes when at least one skill in expected_skills is used. A query with expected_skills == [] passes only when no skill is used. Skill names are matched case-insensitively; multi-skill answers pass when any acceptable skill appears.
rules.runs: Default 3 runs per query for real harnesses; majority of runs decides the observed skill set. Mock mode ignores runs (deterministic).
rules.acceptable_sets: Some prompts accept more than one skill; the set is expected_skills, not a ranking. preferred_skills is only used for the wrong-skill matrix.
rules.threshold: Overall accuracy must be >= 0.90 (25 queries => at most 2 failures).

queries.prompt: The signup email has a typo — fix it.
queries.reason: Small authorized change in the ordinary execution path; smoke-test lane classification + execution discipline.

queries.prompt: Implement T012 in tasks.md.
queries.reason: Ready task from the canonical planning artifact; executing-task owns the task loop.

queries.prompt: Tests are failing and I don't know why.
queries.reason: Cause not proven yet; debugging owns investigation before a fix.

queries.prompt: The test is flaky on CI.
queries.reason: Flaky test = unknown cause, reproduces the systematic-debugging trigger.

queries.prompt: Review this diff before I merge.
queries.reason: Implemented change awaiting review; reviewing-change, not verification or merge.

queries.prompt: Write the PR description for this branch.
queries.reason: PR body is authoring-pr's artifact; excludes merging and evidence production.

queries.prompt: Is this ready to release?
queries.reason: Release-readiness acceptance pass, not verification or authoring.

queries.prompt: Should we build offline mode?
queries.reason: Whether to build is undecided; exploring-idea produces an Idea Note and stops.

queries.prompt: Users want export but we haven't decided how.
queries.reason: Outcome is decided, behavior is not; shaping-feature ends at a Feature Brief.

queries.prompt: Ticket OSA-123 has acceptance criteria; start it.
queries.reason: Tracker work with AC arrives; intaking-ticket builds the checkable criteria table first.

queries.prompt: Work on this in a separate worktree.
queries.reason: Explicit isolation request; using-worktrees owns worktree preparation.

queries.prompt: These three tasks are independent; run them in parallel.
queries.reason: Concurrent work with independent units; parallel-development owns the decision.

queries.prompt: Deploy the new image to staging.
queries.reason: Infra/deploy class of change whose proof is observed system state.

queries.prompt: Write the test first for this validator.
queries.reason: Explicit test-first request; TDD owns the red/green evidence.

queries.prompt: Merge this branch.
queries.reason: Integration/branch disposition; finishing-branch owns merge vs PR vs keep.

queries.prompt: Explain this function.
queries.reason: General explanation, not an engineering workflow task; must not trigger any skill.

queries.prompt: Write a SQL query for this report.
queries.reason: Ordinary coding help with no workflow stage; must not trigger any skill.

queries.prompt: Review my essay.
queries.reason: Lexical near-miss for reviewing-change; content review is not code review.

queries.prompt: Run the tests.
queries.reason: Near-miss for executing-task: running checks to prove a claim belongs to verifying-change.

queries.prompt: Update the README.
queries.reason: Small, authorized change; execution path, not discovery or docs-specific skill.

queries.prompt: Open the PR.
queries.reason: Ambiguous by design: opening a PR is finishing-branch's disposition, but writing its body is authoring-pr; both accepted.

queries.prompt: The AC says 'fast' — is that testable?
queries.reason: Near-miss for debugging/execution: uncheckable acceptance criterion is intake work.

queries.prompt: Create a new project from this BRD.
queries.reason: New project without a codebase; shaping-project, not feature shaping.

queries.prompt: Should we migrate to Postgres?
queries.reason: Decision question, not a ready task; exploring-idea assesses direction.

queries.prompt: Migrate the database to Postgres.
queries.reason: Decided change request that is also a hard LARGE-risk area (data migration); execution path must classify it, not discover or deploy. Near-miss for shipping-infrastructure.
